note:
The gate measured two things it cannot mean, and both were false positives rather than debt: 100 -> 92.

FIRST, A `_compute_*` NAME IS NOT A FIELD COMPUTE. The scan took every FunctionDef whose name starts with `_compute_`, so six helpers that take arguments were graded against a decorator only the ORM's zero-argument compute protocol can carry. `@api.depends_context` on any of them does nothing: the ORM never calls them, their callers do.

    odoo/addons/base/models/ir_rule.py:162          _compute_domain(self, model_name, mode="read")
    addons/base_order/models/account_move_line.py   _compute_warn_msg_from_product(self, field_name, group)
    addons/base_order/models/mixin_order.py         _compute_warning_text(self, target_field)
    addons/base_order/models/mixin_order_line_fields.py  _compute_line_warn_msg(self, target_field)
    addons/base_order/models/product_product.py     _compute_ordered_qty(self, field_name, model, group, date_field, domain)
    addons/base_order/models/res_partner.py         _compute_order_count(self, order_model, count_field, group, domain=None)
    addons/website_payment/controllers/portal.py    _compute_show_tokenize_input_mapping(providers_sudo, **kwargs)

`ir.rule._compute_domain` is the sharpest case: it is `@api.model`, it is ormcached on `self.env.uid` and `self.env.su` explicitly, and it is the ORM record-rule entry point. It already declares its uid dependence in the only form available to a non-field method, and the gate was asking it to declare it again in a form that has no effect. `is_field_compute()` now requires the compute signature the ORM actually calls -- `self` alone, no varargs, no keyword-only -- and is tested over seven signatures.

SECOND, A READ THROUGH A STRIPPED CONTEXT IS NOT A CONTEXT READ. `res_partner._compute_complete_name` does `clean_self = self.with_context({}) if self.env.context else self` and passes `clean_self.env` to `_description_selection`. `complete_name` is `store=True`: one column, one value, so `depends_context("lang")` is not merely unnecessary there, it is the wrong shape -- the `with_context({})` exists precisely so that whoever triggers the recompute cannot decide what lands in the column. The gate was reading the neutralisation as the offence.

`context_free_names()` collects names bound to an expression containing `.with_context()` or `.with_context({})`, and a flagged read whose subtree mentions one of them -- or strips one inline -- is no longer counted. A `with_context(lang="fr_FR")` carries keys and still counts; that is a test.

Both changes lower the count in the addons tree as well as in core. Nothing was fixed in either: the 8 are removed because they were never findings. The sets were diffed rather than the counts compared -- 8 removed, 0 added -- and core (`--roots odoo`) is now 0.
